pages.scan: I read works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-02.png with the Read tool and looked at it. Panel 1 (full-width top): the caption at top left reads 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' The teal label at top right reads 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic'. 'ananya' is in the upper middle and silent. Panel 2 (middle left, wide): the balloon reads 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.' Its tail goes to 'ananya' at right. Panel 3 (middle right): the balloon reads 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.' Its tail goes to 'meera'. The teal label at bottom reads 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff'. Panel 4 (full-width bottom): the balloon in the centre reads 'One team. Better coordination.' Its very short tail goes to 'ananya' at left. 'meera' is at upper right and silent.
pages.observation: The order is natural: caption, label, Ananya, Meera ('And our team...' continues Ananya's line), then the closing line. Layout problems: (1) The caption box and the WELBUK PRACTICE label in panel 1 both sit flush against the panel frame. The caption touches the top edge, and the label touches the top and right edges. The word 'its' nearly touches the right edge of the caption box. (2) In panel 4 the balloon overlaps the ananya placeholder label, which is cut off as 'anany…'. The tail is so short that the balloon looks attached to the figure's edge. In finished art it may cover her face. (3) In panel 4 Meera stands to the right of the balloon, so a reader might briefly attribute 'One team. Better coordination.' to Meera. The tail does point left to Ananya. (4) Moving from page 1 ('Let's make the rest simpler') to the onboarding caption is understandable. No reply is skipped.
